newsitem.title: UK: Biotech hopes for early 98 Zacutex approval.
newsitem.headline: Biotech hopes for early 98 Zacutex approval.

text.p: British Biotech Plc said it hoped to hear early next year whether it was allowed to market its acute pancreatis drug Zacutex in Europe.
"We would hope to hear early next year," a spokeswoman said.
"Acute pancreatis is a life threatening condition and there are currently no approved therapies for it and therefore we would hope that the application would proceeed quite rapidly," she added.
Analysts have forecast Zacutex could eventually reach annual sales between $200 and $300 million.
Some 100,000 people in western Europe and 200,000 in the U.S. suffer from acute pancreatis each year.
British Biotech said earlier today it had applied for approval to market its Zacutex in Europe. The drug would be the firm's first to hit the market.
